about.bio: I build digital products that blend engineering precision with human-centered design. With 9+ years of experience across finance, automotive, and cloud-native platforms, I help teams ship robust interfaces, clean architecture, and reliable business value.

entries.description: Leading product-critical architecture and feature delivery for complex financial applications with strong emphasis on maintainability, trust, and performance.
Built business-critical automotive leasing platforms, improved service reliability, and delivered user-centric workflows across operations and client services.
Developed financial tools and operational systems handling complex rules, data integrity, and time-sensitive business processes.
Shipped IoT-driven dashboards and internal management solutions that connected operational data to practical decision-making.
Started my engineering career by creating web applications with ASP.NET MVC and improving end-to-end user experiences.
